mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voice_sessions ( session_id, user_id, from_account_id, status, current_step, flow_type, stt_mode, entry_point, active_input_turn_id, active_ai_turn_id, lifecycle_generation, started_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{fromAccountId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{status}, #{currentStep}, #{flowType}, #{sttMode}, #{entryPoint}, #{activeInputTurnId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{activeAiTurnId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{lifecycleGeneration}, #{startedAt}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, user_id, from_account_id, transfer_id, status, current_step, flow_type, stt_mode, entry_point, active_input_turn_id, active_ai_turn_id, lifecycle_generation, started_at, ended_at, expires_at FROM voice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND session_id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR}

SELECT session_id, user_id, from_account_id, transfer_id, status, current_step, flow_type, stt_mode, entry_point, active_input_turn_id, active_ai_turn_id, lifecycle_generation, started_at, ended_at, expires_at FROM voice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND session_id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR} FOR UPDATE NOWAIT

SELECT session_id, user_id, from_account_id, transfer_id, status, current_step, flow_type, stt_mode, entry_point, active_input_turn_id, active_ai_turn_id, lifecycle_generation, started_at, ended_at, expires_at FROM voice_sessions WHERE status IN ('LISTENING', 'SPEAKING') AND expires_at > #{now, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
